import html
import re
import unittest
from label_html import escape_label

class LabelEscaping(unittest.TestCase):
    def assert_safe_roundtrip(self, original, result):
        self.assertIs(type(result), str)
        self.assertEqual(html.unescape(result), original)
        entities = re.findall(r'&(?:#[0-9]+|#[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+|[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+);', result)
        for entity in entities:
            self.assertIn(html.unescape(entity), ['&', '<', '>', chr(34), chr(39)])
        self.assertNotIn('<', result)
        self.assertNotIn('>', result)
        self.assertIsNone(re.search(r'&(?!#[0-9]+;|#[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+;|[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+;)', result))

    def test_default_escapes_both_quotes(self):
        original = chr(34) + 'bay' + chr(39) + ' <dock> & pier'
        result = escape_label(original)
        self.assert_safe_roundtrip(original, result)
        self.assertNotIn(chr(34), result)
        self.assertNotIn(chr(39), result)

    def test_false_keeps_quotes_but_escapes_markup(self):
        original = chr(34) + chr(39) + '<&>'
        result = escape_label(original, quote=False)
        self.assert_safe_roundtrip(original, result)
        self.assertTrue(result.startswith(original[:2]))

    def test_ampersand_is_escaped_once_and_plain_text_stays(self):
        self.assert_safe_roundtrip('& & <', escape_label('& & <'))
        self.assertEqual(escape_label('港口 7'), '港口 7')
        self.assertEqual(escape_label(''), '')

    def test_unrelated_characters_remain_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(escape_label('plain / dock = 42 港口 🌙'),
                         'plain / dock = 42 港口 🌙')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
